name: Wrecking Ball
design_intent:
PHYSICS-LAB circuit 4, NEW course (slot 7 of 8, diff 4). Combines the two lab threads — RIDE + BREAK — into one move: get FIRED into a smash wall and BE the demolition charge. This isolates chain_reaction's capstone idea (impact-as-tool) before the finale stacks a bomb field on top. A fixed cannon launches the player at 2600px/s straight into a stack of break_on 'smash' hp1 crates that seals the only corridor to the goal; the impact (2443px/s at contact >> the 900px/s smash gate) punches a hole you then fly through.

VERIFIED IMPACT (Cannon.gd + DestructibleBlock.gd): the cannon is FIXED at -20deg (angle_min==angle_max, no timing read this course). Pivot (700,700); muzzle = pivot + 230*(cos20,-sin20) = (916,621); launch v = (2600cos20, -2600sin20) = (2443,-889). Time to the wall face x2200: dt = (2200-916)/2443 = 0.526s; arc height there y = 621 - 889*0.526 + 800*0.526^2 = 374; contact speed = sqrt(2443^2 + (-47)^2) = 2443px/s. That lands on the MIDDLE crate (crate B, y300-450) at ~2443px/s >> 900 -> a guaranteed smash. Plain boost caps at 760 < 900 (INV-1) and can NEVER break a smash crate, so the cannon (or a super — see below) is the only tool. Because the crate is solid through its 0.28s crack telegraph, the honest sequence (verified against chain_reaction's roof) is TWO strokes: the first cannon ride SMASHES crate B and bounces you back off it (trampoline restitution) as it cracks; 0.28s later it vanishes leaving a 150px hole; the crate STAYS broken across a respawn/reload (in-run persistence), so the SECOND ride sails the identical -20 arc clean through the open hole (at x2200 the arc is y374, dead-centre of the y300-450 hole; player ~92px in a 150px gap = 29px/side = a genuine thread) and on into the goal_gate. At x2950 the arc is y436, inside goal_gate (2830-3070, y330-670) -> the ring latches on the fly-through before the far bumper backstop (x3350) even catches the overshoot. The flanking crates A (y150-300) and C (y450-600) stay intact, so the result reads as a punched HOLE in a wall, not a cleared shelf.
SUPER ALTERNATIVE (like demolition_day): a player may instead boost across to the wall and SUPER crate B (super_active grants smash license at any speed); still a two-stroke break-then-pass, still 100% a flight verb. Boost alone can never do it.

SEALED WALL (verified geometry, no over/under cheese): the barrier at x2200-2400 runs from the bounds ceiling to the void — bumper top cap y-900..150, three smash crates y150..600, bumper base y600..1300 (into the void lip). Flying OVER means climbing from the start pad (y1050) to y<-900 (~1950px) then crossing ~1500px = ~3450px > one tank's ~2660px, with no refuel pads up there -> impossible. Under the base is the void. The crate hole is the only way past.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (flight required):
- Start pad top y1050 -> cannon capture (r70 @ 700,700): 350px climb (>trampoline apex 270) -> BOOST to load.
- Start -> wall: ~1550px over the void, and the wall blocks the low line -> the cannon RIDE (or a boost-then-super approach) is the crossing; a bounce (drift ~527) is hopeless.
- The wall: a smash-grade impact (cannon 2443 or a super) is mandatory; boost 760 < 900 gate cannot break it -> a FLIGHT verb, always.
- Hole -> goal: the winning second ride threads the 150px breach and rings the goal_gate on the fly; a stray overshoot hits the x3350 bumper backstop and rebounds onto the goal pad (trampoline x2650-3350) instead of voiding.
No leg is bounce-crossable and the wall is impassable without a smash impact.

FUEL BUDGET: spawn 100. Load the cannon ~0.8s boost (~23 fuel); both rides are free. The super route costs a tank dump but needs only 5 to fire and the start + goal pads refund +20 per touch. A bounce-back into the void, a mistimed recovery, or a short landing = free respawn at the start_gate; the wall stays broken, so the run never re-tolls the breach.

FAIRNESS: the crates telegraph 0.28s of cracks before vanishing; the wall top cap, base, and far backstop are bumpers (never lethal — the void stays the only killer); the fixed barrel means zero timing luck (that is double_barrel's job); spawn (420,950) is over the start pad, 1500px clear of the wall. Explicit bounds: top -1500 clears the flat -20 arc (apex only ~y374) with room; the derived side-cap would be wrong for this walled corridor.
hint: RIDE THE CANNON — PUNCH A HOLE THROUGH THE WALL
